summary: Implemented load_decathlon_datalist in monai/data/utils.py (signature: data_list_file_path, is_segmentation=True, data_list_key="training", base_dir=None). It reads the Decathlon JSON, joins relative paths with base_dir (defaulting to the JSON file's directory), validates image/label keys for segmentation, drops label when is_segmentation=False, and raises ValueError on a missing key or malformed item. Added tests/test_load_decathlon_datalist.py covering these cases. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions. Choices to review: upstream-style name and signature, and dropping label rather than rejecting it when is_segmentation=False.
